			<title>Stark VARG SM Skoll Breaks Longstanding Track Record</title>
			<link>https://www.newsfilecorp.com/release/315026/Stark-VARG-SM-Skoll-Breaks-Longstanding-Track-Record</link>
			<description><img src="https://api.newsfilecorp.com/newsinfo/315026/156" id="156" width="2" height="2" style="width: 1px;  height: 1px;border: 0px solid;" />Barcelona, Spain--(Newsfile Corp. - September 20, 2026) - Stark Future has set a new lap record at the Autòdrom de Sitges-Terramar. On Thursday 10 September 2026, Stark rider Jonas Skovby lapped the 1923 banked oval in 41.888 seconds on a Stark VARG SM Sköll, beating the 42.600-second record set there by Carlos Sainz in an Audi R8 LMS in 2012. The margin is 0.712 seconds. The machine that took it is a road-legal production motorcycle with no gearbox, no clutch, and no exhaust.¨Constructed in...</description>

			<atom:subtitle>41.888 Seconds. a Record That Had Stood Since 2012, Broken by an Electric Supermoto.</atom:subtitle>
